The '''IRAPS cerebral stabilizer''', nicknamed "Brain cage", was a device produced by [[Chiewab Amalgamated Pharmaceuticals Company]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and cost 2,200 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].It preserved the vitality of the central nervous system in critically injured patients. Consisting of a full face helmet with IV lines injected into the neck, it injected a hyper-oxygenated nutrient solution in the patient's brain to provide metabolic stabilization and its thermal circuits in the helmet would reduce cranial temperature. It could bring [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] back from what is known as brain death.<ref name="DC" />
